component.name: Dendro
component.summary: Visual package manager and dependency hierarchy explorer

description.p: Dendro is a modern, high-performance graphical package manager and visual dependency hierarchy explorer built specifically for Fedora Linux.
Key Features:

ul.li: Native librpm and libdnf5 bindings for sub-millisecond database queries
Two-tier hierarchical package taxonomy backed by Fedora comps and FreeDesktop XDG specifications
Interactive multi-level dependency trees with cycle detection
Two-tier capability resolution caching (L1 RAM plus L2 SQLite WAL)
Dry-run transaction simulation and automatic system root pillar protection
Dynamic light and dark theming with desktop color scheme auto-detection
Privileged execution with Polkit and live streaming terminal output
DNF transaction history exploration and one-click rollback

description.p: System Typography Inheritance, Taxonomy Precision, and Navigation Polish:

ul.li: Inherited desktop environment point sizes and stripped hardcoded pixel font sizes across all dialogs and stylesheets, ensuring complete compliance with system accessibility and display scaling.
Adopted system monospace fonts for package versions, upgrade paths, transaction history commands, dry-run simulation logs, and file manifests.
Fixed contextual header action buttons (Upgrade All, Check Mirrors) failing to activate when opening updates from the header pill, and added a direct return button.
Resolved plasma-desktop misclassification into Web Browsers by detecting FHS shell containments and disambiguating umbrella Network categories.
Resolved kamera and dendro self-classification into Themes & Visual Assets by decoupling settings flags from launcher detection and ignoring standard hicolor app icon paths.
Correctly routed standalone Python CLI tools (ansible, meson, certbot) to Command-Line Utilities and pure documentation (man-pages, git-doc) to Development Headers & SDKs.
Decoupled TreeItem parent back-references to eliminate circular reference memory retention during tree reloads.
Implemented defensive wait cursor state management to prevent cursor freeze bugs, and adopted adaptive screen geometry for laptop displays.
Removed the vestigial confidence percentage badge from the inspector panel.

description.p: GTK 3 Theme Integration, Fedora 45 DNF5 Paths, Desktop Shell Taxonomy Fix, and UI Polish:
Special thanks to Marcin Juszkiewicz for thorough Fedora 45 testing and usability suggestions, and Ricky-Tigg for reporting issue #38.

ul.li: Resolved GTK 3 dark mode detection (Issue #38): Added multi-tier checks across gsettings gtk-theme, settings.ini, XFCE xfconf-query, and GTK_THEME environment variables.
Resolved CodeQL Alert #2: Validated repository hostnames using urllib.parse.urlsplit to eliminate substring sanitization vulnerabilities.
Fixed desktop shell classification: Detected FHS shell layouts and session definitions, routing plasma-desktop, gnome-shell, and compositors to Window Managers & Addons instead of Web Browsers.
Supported Fedora 45+ DNF5 repository relocation: Scanned /usr/share/dnf5/repos.d/ alongside classic /etc/ paths.
Accurately classified third-party repositories and added privileged repository file removal.
Displayed exact installed provider versions (e.g. 1.6.40-2.fc41) in the dependency tree instead of the generic satisfied label.
Fixed right-panel Re-Scan button mutating the central dependency tree.
Added a sidebar toggle button (Ctrl+B) and a direct return action when viewing updates.
Reflowed 70-column hard-wrapped RPM package descriptions and added error-safe busy pointer indicators.

description.p: Capability-Driven Classification, Reverse Dependency Sonames, and Safety Parser Fix:

ul.li: Resolved silent reverse dependency discovery failure by querying all capabilities and ELF sonames provided by a target package, enabling accurate dependent lookups for shared libraries.
Fixed transaction simulation parser to parse the multiline DNF removal section line-by-line, guaranteeing protected package removals are caught across large batches.
Separated Qt5 and Qt6 plugin directories from media decoders, routing platform plugins to GUI frameworks and toolkits rather than media codecs.
Expanded AppStream metadata indexing to scan active DNF5 and DNF repository repodata caches, importing metadata from RPM Fusion and COPR repositories.
Integrated standardized RPM virtual capability extraction for Python distributions, Rust crates, GStreamer elements, and JVM artifacts.
Refactored unit test suite to eliminate scoping collisions and added regression coverage for multiline removal detection.

description.p: Deterministic Taxonomy Overhaul, Decoupled System Protection, and Workflow Polish:

ul.li: Decoupled system protection from core classification: security components (PAM, Polkit, audit, firewalld) and kernel modules now reside in their functional domains rather than being hijacked by fedora_core.
Added first-class is_protected package tracking for deterministic removal safety auditing without category distortion.
Implemented an O(1) constant-time taxonomy override architecture for known upstream packaging quirks.
Enforced strict desktop launcher validation via RPM DIRINDEXES to prevent autostart and background files from qualifying as applications.
Resolved a sidebar counter double-counting defect, aligning badge numbers exactly with visible package rows.
Completed the selective upgrade pipeline: staged upgrades remain visible in Pending Changes and can be executed directly from the transaction drawer.
Introduced dual context menu actions for updatable packages (Queue Upgrade vs. Queue Removal).
Added defensive RPM header timestamp decoding and URL protocol sanitization in the inspector panel.

description.p: Live Mirror Refresh, DNF Cache Cleaner, and Navigation Polish:

ul.li: Added live repository synchronization using the --refresh flag to query remote mirrors directly for new packages.
Integrated a dedicated package cache cleaner into the Repositories dialog (dnf clean all).
Streamlined sidebar navigation by removing redundant view shortcuts and refining toolbar actions.
Fixed a syntax indentation issue in the main window sidebar count aggregator.

description.p: Selective Upgrades, Queue Discard, and Theme Inversion Fix:

ul.li: Introduced selective per-package upgrades, allowing individual packages to be staged and upgraded without running a full system upgrade.
Added a one-click Discard action to instantly revert all staged pending changes across the tree.
Fixed a Qt style collision that caused tree view backgrounds to invert between light and dark themes on systems with host dark mode enabled.
Cleaned up tree hierarchy: packages with zero dependencies no longer show an empty expansion chevron.
Fixed window and system tray icon resolution to display Dendro's application logo instead of generic download arrows.

description.p: In-App Upgrades, Local RPM File Handler, and UI Overhaul:

ul.li: Integrated native in-app system upgrades (dnf upgrade) with Polkit elevation and live streaming terminal logs.
Added one-click batch leaf orphan cleanup (dnf autoremove) for unneeded dependencies.
Registered as a system file handler for local .rpm packages, providing in-process header inspection and direct installation.
Added system tray integration with background update polling and native desktop notifications.
Overhauled sidebar navigation with right-aligned counter pill badges and typographic section dividers.
Refined header bar with grouped secondary tools, search shortcut chip, and micro-bordered status badges in the tree view.

description.p: The Deterministic Taxonomy & Core Pipeline Overhaul:

ul.li: Replaced the heuristic scoring classifier with a deterministic two-phase ontological pipeline anchored to FHS filesystem manifests and FreeDesktop specifications.
Eliminated category cannibalization: interactive desktop media players are verified as applications before domain checks, preventing misclassification into the hardware stack.
Strict desktop launcher validation: autostart services, Akonadi agents, and background helper desktop files are no longer promoted to GUI desktop applications.
Resolved CLI utility identification for tools utilizing internal helper libraries in /usr/libexec (e.g. 7zip).
Fixed headless runtime identification, ensuring packages like java-*-openjdk-headless remain under language runtimes rather than graphical applications.
Purged obsolete heuristic scoring code and synchronized unit tests for 100% deterministic test assertion.

description.p: Source Archive Case-Alignment and Build Fix:

ul.li: Resolved rpmbuild source archive filename mismatch occurring when building directly from GitHub release tarballs (Dendro-2.0.1.tar.gz vs dendro-2.0.1.tar.gz).
Synchronized source directory extraction macros across dendro.spec and COPR build scripts to ensure flawless mock and local source RPM generation.

description.p: The Two-Tier System Taxonomy, Visual Contrast, and Native Safety Audit Release:

ul.li: Introduced a complete two-tier hierarchical taxonomy across 6 core system pillars, adding granular FreeDesktop subcategories for desktop applications and command-line tools.
Integrated automatic ingestion of Fedora comps.xml distribution compose metadata from local DNF caches to eliminate package categorization guesswork.

Resolved light and dark theme icon contrast issues: dynamically synchronizes QApplication palette text colors with FreeDesktop symbolic SVGs, eliminating invisible white-on-white or dark-on-dark icons.
Differentiated programming runtimes: assigned dedicated vector icons for Rust, Java, and Node.js, replacing the repeated development hammer icon.
Integrated native in-process system removal safety assessment in the package inspector, reporting protected root status and leaf orphan safety without external daemon requirements.
Purged all raw unicode emoji fonts and glyphs across the entire application interface to ensure complete Fontconfig stability.

description.p: Native FreeDesktop Icon Migration & Fontconfig Fix:

ul.li: Completely resolved a startup segmentation fault in libfontconfig (FcCharSetFindLeafForward) occurring when Qt measured layout button dimensions containing raw emoji characters (#32).
Migrated all buttons, category labels, dialogs, and table indicators from raw unicode emojis to native FreeDesktop vector theme icons (QIcon).
Improved desktop integration and theme consistency across GNOME and KDE Plasma environments.

description.p: Critical Fontconfig Startup Fix:

ul.li: Resolved a low-level segmentation fault (SIGSEGV) in libfontconfig.so.1 (FcCharSetFindLeafForward / FcCharSetHasChar) occurring on Fedora systems during window layout initialization (#32).
Removed explicit color emoji families from the global application font stack, standardizing on system sans-serif fonts to avoid font cache dereference errors during QPushButton size calculations.

description.p: Build Toolchain & Packaging Alignment Update:

ul.li: Fixed Fedora 43 COPR/mock build dependency resolution by aligning pyproject.toml setuptools requirements with distribution baseline (setuptools >= 61.0.0).
Modernized minimum Python runtime baseline to Python 3.12+ across build configurations and documentation.
Upgraded Flatpak manifest to the active KDE 6.9 runtime branch, replacing the deprecated 6.6 runtime.

description.p: The Qt 6.8+ Stability Hotfix and Diagnostics Update:

ul.li: Fixed C++ segmentation fault (SIGSEGV) occurring under Qt 6.8+ caused by re-entrant proxy model layout signals during background package queries.
Refactored package orphan, user-installed, and update status notifications into a single-batch dataChanged emission to prevent proxy table corruption.
Disabled setAutoAcceptChildRows on the proxy filter to prevent invalid recursive mapping across lazy-loaded row hierarchies.
Integrated native Python faulthandler in main.py to automatically dump C-level tracebacks to stderr if a low-level crash occurs.

description.p: The Standards-Based Classification Engine Overhaul:

ul.li: Re-engineered classification from heuristic string matching to a deterministic contract pipeline.
Integrated native RPM Provides: application() verification to ensure only true desktop launchers are promoted to Desktop Applications.
Added system-level Window Manager detection via firstboot(windowmanager) and XDG Categories.
Added Input Method subsystem detection, correctly assigning daemons like IBus to background services.
Replaced hardcoded root pillars with dynamic system protection detection from /etc/dnf/protected.d/ and running kernel definitions.

description.p: The Engine Hardening and Core Crash Fix Update:

ul.li: Switched user-installed, leaf package, and history workers to isolated subprocesses to eliminate libdnf5 SWIG null pointer segfaults.
Synchronized layoutAboutToBeChanged and layoutChanged across all tree mutations.
Enforced reentrant thread locking across native librpm calls.
Hooked dependency resolution strictly to on-demand tree expansion.

description.p: The Stability and Theme Reactivity Hotfix:

ul.li: Resolved native segmentation fault occurring after startup due to Qt proxy model persistent index desynchronization.
Synchronized layout signals across all model updates.
Enforced reentrant thread locking and explicit match iterator teardown across native librpm calls.
Resolved theme adaptation defects across dark and light palettes.

description.p: Fix missing QIcon import in main.py
The Security Auditing, System Updates, and Engine Reliability Update:

ul.li: Integrated package file integrity and tamper auditor (rpm -V engine).
Added native RPM changelog viewer with automated Red Hat CVE and Bugzilla linkification.
Added live system updates and security advisories engine powered by dnf5 check-upgrade.
Introduced graphical Software Repository and COPR channel manager.
Added dedicated Available Updates and User-Installed Packages sidebar channels.

description.p: The Deterministic Classification and Engine Reliability Update:

ul.li: Implemented full 10-component FreeDesktop AppStream catalog taxonomy.
Fixed NoDisplay=true settings trap and Terminal=true desktop launcher promotion.
Added user-installed package provenance tracking.
Added sequential multi-stage Polkit transaction runner for concurrent operations.
